nav.title: Indawo yokuxhumana ye-AI
nav.subtitle: Insizakalonke yezilimi eziningi ngokudluliselwa okulawulekile komuntu.

customer.title: Qala ingxoxo
customer.consentText: Ngiyavuma ukuthi lo mxoxo uqhatyuswe umhlinzeki we-AI ohleliwe. Imibhalo ibethwa ngaphambi kokugcinwa.
customer.setupHint: Ayitholakali kuze umqhamuki alungiselele ukhiye wokubethela nomhlinzeki we-AI.
customer.chatEmpty: Imilayezo yakho izophela lapha. Izinzameko ze-AI yiziphakamiso kuphela; akukho kokukhokha, ukushintshwa kwama-akhawunti, ukubuyiselwa noma ukuthumela okwenziwayo.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Izwi lesiphequluli lihanjiswa ngokusakaza kumhlinzeki olungiselelwe; i-OpsCore ayitsheli ukuthi igcina umsindo ongaphelele.
customer.voiceRequirement: Izwi lesiphequluli idinga i-HTTPS (noma i-localhost), imakrofoni, imvume, imodeli ye-Realtime elungiselelwe nokhiye womhlinzeki. Akuyona ibhuloho locingo le-PSTN/SIP.

queue.title: Umqhamo wokuphakama
queue.description: Lapha kuyavela izingxoxo zengozi ephezulu, ezingaxazululwa noma ezicela umuntu. Into kuq kusho ukucelwe, hhayi ukuxhumanisa.
queue.empty: Akukho ukudluliselwa komuntu okusebenzayo kule nhlangano.
queue.replyStorageNote: Izimpendulo zabantu ziyabethelwa uma zigcinwa futhi ziyabonakala kumbhalo wengxoxo.

boundaries.title: Imingcele yokusebenza
boundaries.automateBody: Impendulo yokuqala yezilimi eziningi, ukuqonda, ukuhlukanisa inhloso kanye nengozi, ukugcina okubhalwe ngendlela ephephile, ukwakha amaqoqo nokunikeza abaqaphi.
boundaries.humanBody: Isicelo somuntu esicacile, ukuthembeka okuphansi, ingozi ephezulu noma eyisibusiso, umthetho ongatholakali, icala elingaxazululwanga, ikhalo le-evisi/ukuphepha noma isenzo esingaqinile.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: Ukugqamisa PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/imeyili, ibhulohwe lefoni elebhu, ukuqinisekiswa kwesithombe CRM kanye nangokwethembwa kwendlela yokuthetha kudinga isixhumanisi somhlinzeki sangempela, izimfanelo kanye no ukuhlolwa kwamukelwa.

messages.qualificationNotice: Ayikho ilimi elihlelelwe ukukhiqiza kuze kudlulela ukuhlolwa kombhalo, ukuzwa ngesizwi, ukwakheka kwezwi, ukunethezeka kanye nokuphakama.
messages.configOk: Ukulungiselela kukhona. Ukuxhumaniswa nomhlinzeki kanye nangokuthuthukiswa kolimi kusadinga ukuhlolwa kwamukelwa okwenziwayo.
messages.conversationCreated: Ingxoxo ephephile yakhinyaniswa. Ukuthuthukiswa kolimi kungekakho kuqinga kokukhiqiza.
messages.handoffQueued: Ukudluliselwa komuntu kuq kugciniwe ({reason}). Lokhu kuyisicelo esiq, hhayi uxhumaniso lwelele.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Impendulo ye-AI ayiqedekile. Akukho senzo esenziwe. Ungacela umqaphi womuntu.
messages.apiUnavailable: I-API ye-Contact Center ayikwazanga ukulayishwa. Ngena kukhonsoli ye-OpsCore, bese uyilayisha kabusha leli khasi.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Ukudlulisela kumuntu kufakwe emgqeni ({reason}). Umugqa awubonisi ukuthi ummeli uxhumekile.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Ukudlulisela kumuntu kufakwe emgqeni. Iseshini ye-AI yesiphequluli iyama; ukudlulisela ucingo bukhoma akulungiselelwe.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Umhlinzeki wesikhathi sangempela unikeze umbiko wephutha. Misa iseshini yezwi bese uyazama futhi ngemva kokuhlola ukulungiselelwa komhlinzeki.
messages.voiceActive: Iseshini yezwi iyasebenza. Cindezela “Cela umqaphi womuntu” noma nini; lokhu kudala into emgqeni, hhayi ukudlulisela kwe-PSTN.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Imvume iyadingeka ngaphambi kokuthi ingxoxo iqale.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Lesi siphequluli asisekeli izwi lesikhathi sangempela.
